prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a parking lot collision. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1015; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: The vehicle presents rear bumper cover fracture, right quarter panel crease, and a cracked tail lamp housing, all consistent with the low-speed contact reported at the parking lot. The pattern of deformation lines up with the described impact, and no older repair work or prior damage is evident on the panels or fasteners. Proposed repair involves replacing the bumper cover, refinishing the quarter panel, and installing a new lamp assembly, with labor hours that fit the extent of the damage. Invoices submitted for the job show no duplicated or repeated charges.
